research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 1 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.

lede: Washington Commanders carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#15 in EPA per play), while Philadelphia Eagles owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#6 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Philadelphia Eagles -6.0 with a fair total of 43.1 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Philadelphia Eagles pass offence vs Washington Commanders pass defence, which sits +0.122 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
